title: Darjeeling Hill Escape
shortDescription: Darjeeling doesn't need to announce itself; the mist, the mountain air and the distant outline of Kanchenjunga do that quietly on its behalf.
description: Darjeeling doesn't need to announce itself; the mist, the mountain air and the distant outline of Kanchenjunga do that quietly on its behalf. Perched in the foothills of West Bengal, the town carries its British-era past lightly through old churches, heritage buildings and the famous Himalayan Railway that still winds its way through the hills with unhurried charm. Tiger Hill's sunrise views kick the classic experiences off convincingly, the Himalayan panorama doing what it always does best.

Scenic drives through Kurseong and Mirik, monastery visits, tea garden walks and lively Mall Road evenings fill the days between with texture and warmth. It's the kind of hill station that slows you down whether you planned for it or not, and you leave grateful for that.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra to Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Arrive at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport and transfer to Darjeeling via the scenic hill town of Kurseong. Enjoy picturesque views along the historic Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train) route, passing through Tung, Sonada, and Ghoom. Check in to the hotel upon arrival and relax amidst the cool mountain atmosphere. Spend the evening exploring the lively Mall Road, enjoying a leisurely walk, pony rides, local cafés, and views of the surrounding hills.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Begin the day early with a visit to Tiger Hill to witness a spectacular sunrise over Mount Kanchenjunga (weather permitting). En route back, visit the historic Ghoom Monastery and the engineering marvel of Batasia Loop. After breakfast, explore Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock, Ropeway View Point, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, Happy Valley Tea Garden (outer view), and the peaceful Japanese Peace Pagoda. Return to the hotel after a day filled with cultural and natural attractions.

itinerary.title: Mirik Excursion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a scenic excursion to Mirik, a charming hill destination surrounded by pine forests and tea gardens. Visit the beautiful Sumendu Lake (Mirik Lake) and enjoy the serene surroundings. Optional boating is available at an additional cost. Stop at the Indo–Nepal border (Pashupati Market), where Indian citizens can enjoy a brief walk into the neighbouring Nepalese market area. Return to Darjeeling while enjoying panoramic views of the hills and tea plantations.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and spend some time at leisure. Check out and transfer to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for your onwards journey. Depart with wonderful memories of Darjeeling's mountains, tea gardens, and Himalayan landscapes.
